verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. The Lean correction is editU P A c (X, η) = A(η) · u_c(X) and editE = A(η) · e_c(X) (ModulatedHistories.lean:794-798), A being the fixed positive smooth amplitude factored out of the moments; the paper writes u_c, e_c with the amplitude absorbed. physical_mixed_edits_bound bounds every mixed jet ∂_η^j ∂_X^k of both edits by K·eps for all k, j ≤ q and all X ∈ ℝ, given FiniteJetBound q c S eps on the coefficient family. The rewriting: take q ≥ 2 (so k ≤ 1 and j ≤ 2 are covered, which is exactly max_{r≤1} and ‖·‖₂), S = [-1,1], and eps = C/N supplied by exists_actual_restoring_repair for every N ≥ N0; the bound becomes K·C/N. The Lean is more general in the orders (all k, j ≤ q, arbitrary q) and in the radial range (all X, not just J). One further encoding difference: the Lean edits the field F = E/√(2X) via editF = editE/√(2X), where the paper edits E directly.
